portfolio.benchmark: same-date complete-case eligible universe for each signal and timing target

limitations: OPEN_TO_CLOSE_D0 uses the official/shadow open as a reference even though the opening print reveals the signal; this is an optimistic execution proxy, not proof of actual fill.
CLOSE_TO_CLOSE assumes the signal observed after open can be routed to the same-day closing auction; auction cutoff, fill price and queue are not modelled.
NEXT_OPEN baseline retains the previous SSO timing convention and may be late for an opening-known signal.
Minimum commission, bid-ask spread, price-limit queue, partial fills and market impact are not modelled.
2024+ has been inspected in previous SSO research and is not a pristine holdout.
Historical point-in-time universe / delisted securities survivorship audit is incomplete.
Daily TopN results are independent cohorts, not a compounded capital account backtest.
